frozen.pointe_commit_note: origin/main at the build's start; this branch adds only bench/ and tests/ files, and the runner refuses a paid run when anything else differs from this commit

amendments.what: llm-router and naive actuation (adapters/spoken.py): nothing is typed while a permission dialog is open
amendments.why: in paid run act-20261123-031705 the router chose send for a question while a prompt was pending; the adapter typed it into the open dialog and Enter pressed its default Yes (item act006). A harness wiring fault, not the router's decision. naive already had this rule.
amendments.consequence: run act-20261123-031705 (43 rows) is aborted and not published; every arm is run again from the start in the next run. The Pointe commit, the router prompt, the items and the audio are unchanged.

earlier.why: the published run before the fixes of the benchmark findings; its reference arms still stand

frozen.rerun: Pointe arm only, after Pointe fixed what this suite found; same agent model, items, seeds and settings. Reference arms run no Pointe code: their rows come from the earlier run.

stopped: stopped by the operator and not used: launched beside two other benchmarks on a loaded machine (the first), then its daemons found the ports still held by the first one's daemons (the second, 4 error rows, $0)
